name: battery-capsule-holder
description: 6-pocket organic sculptural drawer holder for teardrop battery capsules — nested 180°-alternating teardrop sockets, smooth dune-hull outer body, sliding fit, non-slip base

testPrintCandidates.reason: Pocket long axis 28.5 mm and narrow axis 24.4 mm are fit-critical; 0.70 mm diametric clearance is within the range where first-layer squish and extrusion variation can tighten the pocket and prevent drop-in. A single-pocket test slug verifies fit before printing the full 6-pocket rack.

Chamfer sits exactly at the 45° overhang threshold. A single-socket test piece confirms the chamfer prints cleanly without support and provides a smooth funnel edge rather than a rough drooping surface.

testPrintCandidates.feature: inter-socket bridge at nested tip-to-arc interface
testPrintCandidates.reason: The thinnest wall between adjacent sockets in the nested 180° layout must be verified ≥ 1.2 mm. A 2-socket test piece (one 0° + one 180° at nested pitch) confirms the bridge is solid and not underextruded at the narrow point.
